caption: The video captures an outdoor clearing of patchy grass and bare dirt, bordered by trees, where a pile of discarded cardboard boxes burns. A gray box printed with 'YAN' sits at the front, a white-and-blue 'zoey' box lies to its right, and an open white box and a brown box cluster behind them around charred wood and white ash. Bright orange-yellow flames rise from the boxes and continue flickering, elongating, and curling throughout the clip. Thin smoke drifts upward and to the right, becoming more apparent as the segment progresses. The boxes themselves remain stationary, neither collapsing nor shifting, while the gray 'YAN' surface darkens slightly with soot. Over the sequence the framing gradually widens, the camera pulling back so the burning pile occupies a smaller fraction of the view. More of the surrounding grass, dirt, and background trees appear as the view expands. The fire remains active throughout, neither starting nor finishing within the excerpt.
relations: Active flames on the boxes continue flickering, elongating, and curling throughout the clip.
Rising heat from the fire makes thin smoke drift upward and right, growing more apparent.
Burning cardboard and charred wood cause the gray YAN box surface to darken slightly with soot.
The camera pull-back widens the framing so the stationary burning pile occupies a smaller fraction of view.
